change: bff persona list projection now calls _project_persona_dto(thin_source_health=True) -> overlay_source_health_truth(thin=True); overlay outputs (already fresh copies) are not re-copied via json round trip on the list path only. Detail path unchanged.

measurement.method: time.process_time, best of 3, 160 personas, each with ~132KB health + ~103KB receipt blobs in connector truth; same machine, same process; before = rich DTO + _strip_persona_list_source_health_detail (previous code path), after = _project_persona_list_records

acceptance.1_thin_no_rich: test_list_projection_never_builds_rich_source_health (rich bindings builder patched to raise; _source_truth_projection always thin=True)
acceptance.2_field_identical: test_thin_rows_match_previous_projection_field_for_field compares old vs new on same records with real overlay; all scalar status fields identical. Documented difference: list rows no longer carry rich-only blobs that thin mode never builds: dataSourceStatus.connector_health/connectorHealth and per-dataSources connector_schedule/connector_freshness/source_health/usage_aggregate_30d/recommendation (+camelCase). Previously only sourceHealthBindings and required_source_health were stripped, so these blobs were still shipped in list rows (hence 127 MB before in the synthetic worst case). No in-repo consumer reads them from the list; this is a deliberate shape change flagged for reviewer.
acceptance.5_detail_unchanged: detail path code untouched (thin_source_health defaults False); test_detail_dto_keeps_full_rich_source_health
acceptance.6_tests: No existing test weakened or deleted; only additions to test_bff_persona_list_compact_rows.py. 12 failures in test_persona_router.py are pre-existing at base (identical failing set before and after change).

second_directory_read: Not changed. _get_persona_directory_snapshot still does the market-defaults read for the list (it feeds catalog_default_total); CPU not profiled separately, out of scope for the 70% target.
hosted_verification: deferred to operator acceptance task; no VM access used
